chapterInfo.content:
1
Nehemia awerɛhoɔ ne ne mpaebɔ
1Hakalia ba Nehemia nsɛm nie. Na bosome Kislew#1.1 KISLEW: Ɛte sɛ bosome Obubuo mpaemu kɔsi Ɔpɛnimma bosome mpaemu. mu, afe a ɛtɔ so aduonu a mewɔ Susan aban mu no, 2Hanani, me nuanom mu baako, ne mmarima bi a wɔfiri Yuda bae. Na mebisaa wɔn Yudafoɔ a wɔfirii mu firiiɛ, a wɔkaa nnommumfa no mu no ne Yerusalem ho asɛm. 3#2 Be 36.19 Na wɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Nnommum no nkaeɛ a wɔaka wɔ asase no soɔ no wɔ amaneɛ kɛseɛ ne ahohora mu, na Yerusalem afasuo no abubu, na n’apono nso, wɔde ogya ahye.
4 # Neh 9.1; Esra 9.3 Na metee nsɛm yi no, metenaa ase mesui, na medii abooboo nna bi, na medii abuada, na mebɔɔ mpaeɛ ɔsoro Nyankopɔn no anim, 5#Neh 4.14; Dan 9.4 na mese: Ao, AWURADE, ɔsoro Nyankopɔn, Onyankopɔn kɛseɛ a ne ho yɛ hu a wokora apam ne adɔeɛ ma wɔn a wɔdɔ woɔ ne wɔn a wɔdi wo mmara nsɛm soɔ no, 6ma w’aso mmra so na w’aniwa mmue, na fa tie w’akoa mpaeɛ a merebɔ no w’anim nnɛ awia ne anadwo ama wo nkoa Israelfoɔ, ne ka a mereka Israelfoɔ bɔne a yɛayɛ woɔ no; na me nso ne m’agya fie ayɛ bɔne. 7Fom na yɛafom woɔ, na yɛanni wo mmara nsɛm ne ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmudeɛ a wohyɛɛ w’akoa Mose no so. 8Na kae asɛm a wode hyɛɛ w’akoa Mose no sɛ: Mo deɛ, mofom a, me nso mɛbɔ mo apete aman mu. 9#Deut 30.4 Na sɛ mosane ba me nkyɛn, na mohwɛ me mmara nsɛm di so a, ɛnneɛ sɛ wɔpamo mo kɔ ɔsoro ano nohoa a, ɛhɔ ara na mɛfiri maboaboa mo ano mede mo aba faako a mayi sɛ mɛma me din atena hɔ no. 10Na wɔn nso wɔyɛ wo nkoa ne wo man a wode wo tumi kɛseɛ ne wo nsa a ɛyɛ den agye wɔn. 11Ao, AWURADE, ma w’aso mmra w’akoa mpaebɔ ne wo nkoa a wo din suro yɛ wɔn fɛ mpaebɔ so, na ma no nsi w’akoa yie nnɛ, na ma no mmɔborɔhunu ɔbarima yi anim.
Nso na mene ɔhene nsahyɛni wɔ ɛberɛ no mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Hakalia ba Nehemia nsɛm nie. Na bosome Kislew mu, afe a ɛtɔ so aduonu a mewɔ Susan aban mu no, Hanani, me nuanom mu baako, ne mmarima bi a wɔfiri Yuda bae. Na mebisaa wɔn Yudafoɔ a wɔfirii mu firiiɛ, a wɔkaa nnommumfa no mu no ne Yerusalem ho asɛm. Na wɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Nnommum no nkaeɛ a wɔaka wɔ asase no soɔ no wɔ amaneɛ kɛseɛ ne ahohora mu, na Yerusalem afasuo no abubu, na n’apono nso, wɔde ogya ahye.
Na metee nsɛm yi no, metenaa ase mesui, na medii abooboo nna bi, na medii abuada, na mebɔɔ mpaeɛ ɔsoro Nyankopɔn no anim, na mese: Ao, AWURADE, ɔsoro Nyankopɔn, Onyankopɔn kɛseɛ a ne ho yɛ hu a wokora apam ne adɔeɛ ma wɔn a wɔdɔ woɔ ne wɔn a wɔdi wo mmara nsɛm soɔ no, ma w’aso mmra so na w’aniwa mmue, na fa tie w’akoa mpaeɛ a merebɔ no w’anim nnɛ awia ne anadwo ama wo nkoa Israelfoɔ, ne ka a mereka Israelfoɔ bɔne a yɛayɛ woɔ no; na me nso ne m’agya fie ayɛ bɔne. Fom na yɛafom woɔ, na yɛanni wo mmara nsɛm ne ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmudeɛ a wohyɛɛ w’akoa Mose no so. Na kae asɛm a wode hyɛɛ w’akoa Mose no sɛ: Mo deɛ, mofom a, me nso mɛbɔ mo apete aman mu. Na sɛ mosane ba me nkyɛn, na mohwɛ me mmara nsɛm di so a, ɛnneɛ sɛ wɔpamo mo kɔ ɔsoro ano nohoa a, ɛhɔ ara na mɛfiri maboaboa mo ano mede mo aba faako a mayi sɛ mɛma me din atena hɔ no. Na wɔn nso wɔyɛ wo nkoa ne wo man a wode wo tumi kɛseɛ ne wo nsa a ɛyɛ den agye wɔn. Ao, AWURADE, ma w’aso mmra w’akoa mpaebɔ ne wo nkoa a wo din suro yɛ wɔn fɛ mpaebɔ so, na ma no nsi w’akoa yie nnɛ, na ma no mmɔborɔhunu ɔbarima yi anim.
Nso na mene ɔhene nsahyɛni wɔ ɛberɛ no mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
